module: Applies the legacy body color from the vehicle configuration (vehicleConfig.colors, old format) to the vehicle object: colors[1] -> vehicleObj.color, colors[2] -> colorPalette0, colors[3] -> colorPalette1. Each entry is an array {r, g, b, a} converted to a linear color. Replaced by jbeam/sections/paints for the current format (paints).
notes: No validation: an entry with fewer than 4 components will give nils in ColorF.
Called in loadBundle on the GE side before paints.process, which can overwrite the same properties.

process.desc: Sets color, colorPalette0 and colorPalette1 of the vehicle object from vehicleConfig.colors if it exists.
